name: Yamunotsav
gathering: A festival for a river nobody celebrates. Nine Junes at the India Habitat Centre, every one of them on World Environment Day.

when.note: 5 June is World Environment Day. The date was not a coincidence and it never moved.

how.p: 5 June, World Environment Day, at the India Habitat Centre. The date is the argument: the one day a year the country is officially willing to talk about the environment, spent on the river running through its capital.

holes.what: It ran nine times and then it stopped in 2014. This page does not say why, because nobody has told us.
holes.unlocks: One sentence on why 2014 was the last one — and whether it is coming back.

holes.what: Nine editions and not one photograph on this page. The frames sit in a Drive folder that will not open for us.
holes.unlocks: Access to the Yamunotsav folder. Nine Junes of a river festival is the best unshown material Swechha has.
